findings.description: At q=1 at night, light merges into a bright blob that obscures individual coloured bulbs and their chase.
White pins are weakly separated from cream board, especially at 390 width; slightly larger upper body and stronger red neck would read better.
Kettle is recognisable close up, but its plain round body has less material detail than the existing battery. Prepare a body-only reference after the city houses; no generation ordered.

limitations: No physical iPad, PWA, touch timing or GPU/FPS measurements.
Synthetic gallery placement; real machine layout unchanged.
Programmatic wiring in 1180 party, native pointer wires in 390 party.
Ray check excludes terminal metal and transparent effects; only sampled poses, no full interaction proof.
